i.norm:
Verifies that {@link Gaussian.Parametric#gradient(double, double[])} rejects an invalid standard deviation.

The parameter array passed to a Gaussian's parametric methods holds three values in order: {@code [normalization, mean, sigma]}. The standard deviation {@code sigma} must be strictly positive; supplying {@code 0} for it is illegal.
A {@code sigma} of zero must cause {@code gradient} to fail, because the standard deviation is required to be strictly positive.
invalid: sigma must be strictly positive
